tasks.short: Select preparation and storage methods for laboratory media

steps.what: Review applicable media preparation and storage specifications
Check the medium, intended growth purpose and relevant batch conditions
Select preparation and storage methods that preserve pH, sterility and growth support
Enter selected methods and necessary conditions in the existing media batch worksheet

tasks.design: Link current media specifications and reuse the existing batch-method fields in {DOCS}. The technologist checks the actual medium and selects its methods; software does not infer sterility or growth suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current method references and recreating stable batch headings repeat work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and existing worksheet fields can preserve those references and headings.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate conditions depend on medium, purpose and batch circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: Judge compatibility of the method with the intended laboratory use.
tasks.altitude: Reduce method-reference handling without delegating media judgement.

reach.task: Prepare and store the selected medium
reach.learn: Use the selected method and explicit conditions

evidence.claim: Current specification links and existing worksheet fields can reduce repeated reference handling; local savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: The batch worksheet already carries method selection for later preparation and storage. No separate method-selection log is added.

The technologist verifies medium identifier, batch, intended use and current procedure version in s1-s2 and captures actual method and conditions in s4. Capture and saves remain within nine writing hours; missing specifications require manual verification before selection.
Current-method links remove 6 of 30 reference-navigation hours. Stable method headings remove 1 of 10 worksheet hours; actual parameter selection and content remain human.
No pH sensor, sterility flag, automatic method selection or storage alert is implied. Ordinary author saves have no approval gate.
unknowns: Whether batch worksheets already reuse method headings
research_questions: Does direct reference access remove actual search time after checking current specification versions?

already_counted.description: Capture selected methods and actual conditions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=93, gross 7 less 1 upkeep gives 6 net. Poorly indexed batch-specific specifications retaining all 30 lookup and nine worksheet hours have the one-hour saving offset by upkeep. Comparable media references retaining 26 lookup and nine worksheet hours plus other 60 and 1 upkeep yield 4 net. Batch checking and method selection stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate unacceptable specimens and suitable remediation

steps.what: Verify the unacceptable specimen finding and applicable acceptance requirements
Determine appropriate remediation for future specimen submissions
Capture the verified specimen issue and remediation in the existing laboratory record
Write the specimen communication using existing rejection and remediation wording
Check the final specimen communication and responsible recipient details
Communicate the checked specimen issue to responsible parties within the organization
Communicate the checked specimen issue to responsible external submitters

tasks.design: Use existing specimen issue fields in {OTHER}, the laboratory information system, and reusable response wording in {DOCS}. The technologist verifies rejection facts, chooses remediation, records them and writes the communication before separate checked internal or external sends.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated specimen context and standard collection wording are reconstructed for each communication.
tasks.enabler_now: Native issue fields and established response text can preserve that stable content.
tasks.still_hard: The reason for rejection and safe remediation must fit the actual specimen.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what went wrong and how the submitter can avoid repeating it.

reach.learn: Understand the actual rejection reason and required collection change

evidence.claim: Native issue fields and reusable laboratory response text can reduce repeated writing; local effects are unmeasured.

assumptions: The specimen issue record and communication are existing records used for specimen traceability and remediation. No additional rejection activity log is introduced.

The technologist verifies specimen identifier and observed defect in s1, chooses remediation in s2 and produces issue code, narrative and required collection change in s3. Capture is included in 16 retained record hours; no pre-existing rejection code is assumed. Unclear defects or unavailable codes require manual narrative and review.

Existing specimen context fields remove 4 of 20 record-writing hours. Reusing applicable standard rejection and collection text removes 8 of 20 communication-writing hours; specific facts and remediation remain human.
The send routes are aggregate internal/external cases, not two required sends for every specimen. No automatic rejection, message or author-save approval is implied.
unknowns: Actual case mix of routine and unusual specimen issues
research_questions: Does reuse reduce total work after capturing the actual defect and tailoring remediation?

already_counted.description: Capture issue facts, write actual communication and check the final version

incremental.description: Maintain rejection fields and current response wording

approvals.approved_version: Exact specimen identifier, rejection facts, remediation and internal recipients checked in s5; changes invalidate the check
Exact checked rejection communication and permitted external recipients from s5; changed version or recipient invalidates the check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=88, gross 12 less 1 upkeep gives 11 net. Unusual specimen issues retaining all record writing and 19 communication hours have their one-hour saving offset by upkeep. Comparable collection issues retaining 18 record and 14 communication hours plus other 60 and 1 upkeep yield 7 net. Defect verification, remediation judgement, final check and actual sends remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify suitable specimen collection, preservation and transport methods

steps.what: Clarify the specimen, requested examination and actual collection or transport constraints
Find and read current collection, preservation and transport method references
Identify appropriate specimen collection, preservation and transport methods for the actual request
Write the selected methods and conditions in the existing request instruction fields

tasks.design: Use indexed approved method references in {DOCS} and the existing request instruction fields in {OTHER}, the laboratory information system. The technologist identifies the suitable method and writes actual conditions; no free-form protocol recommendation is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searching across collection and transport references repeats navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: An indexed native reference list can expose the current applicable procedures.
tasks.still_hard: The specimen and actual transport conditions may fall outside routine instructions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when standard handling will not preserve the specimen adequately.
tasks.altitude: Reduce reference searching while retaining protocol suitability judgement.

reach.task: Handle specimens under the selected conditions
reach.learn: Read actual time and preservation constraints

evidence.claim: Indexed approved laboratory references can reduce search without selecting an appropriate specimen method automatically.

assumptions: Selected method and conditions already appear in request instructions used for collection and handling. No separate selection log or instruction send is added.

The technologist verifies specimen type, test and actual timing constraints in s1, checks procedure version in s2 and captures selected method and conditions in s4. Capture is included in 13.5 retained writing hours; absent or conflicting references require manual clarification.

Indexing current references removes 7.5 of 30 retrieval hours while retaining substantive reading. Existing request headings remove 1.5 of 15 instruction-writing hours; all method choice and case-specific content stay human.
Ordinary same-system author saves have no approval stage. Physical collection, preservation and transport execution are not named machine actions in this design.
unknowns: Proportion of requests outside routine handling conditions
research_questions: Does indexed reference access reduce real search time after checking version and applicability?

already_counted.description: Capture selected methods and actual request conditions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=91, gross 9 less 1 upkeep gives 8 net. Rare specimen conditions requiring full reference search retain all 30 retrieval and 14 instruction-writing hours, offsetting one removed hour with upkeep. Well-indexed comparable procedures retaining 25 retrieval and 14 instruction hours plus other 55 and 1 upkeep yield 5 net. Context verification and method judgement remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise subordinate laboratory staff and coordinate support

steps.what: Review laboratory workload, current procedures and staff competence context
Determine suitable laboratory assignments and staff support priorities
Write chosen assignments in the existing laboratory staffing plan
Communicate the final assignments and priorities to subordinate staff
Supervise staff performing laboratory work and identify problems requiring intervention
Coach staff and resolve immediate laboratory work problems within delegated authority
outputs: delivered staff support and unresolved issues

steps.what: Update unresolved support items in the existing laboratory work plan
inputs: delivered staff support and unresolved issues

tasks.design: Use native workload context in {OTHER}, the laboratory information system, and existing staff context in {LMS}. Reuse the work-plan fields in {DOCS}, keeping assignment choice, allocation writing, staff communication, observation and coaching distinct.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated workload navigation and stable work-plan fields add supervision handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and existing staffing-plan structure can remove those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Safe delegation and practical performance require direct judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Notice staff difficulties and intervene constructively.
tasks.altitude: Reduce real work-plan repetition around staff supervision.

reach.learn: Keep unresolved work separate from completed coaching

evidence.claim: Native workload views and existing staffing-plan fields can reduce repeated handling; supervision and coaching remain human.

assumptions: The existing laboratory work plan carries assignments and unresolved work for supervisor and shift follow-up. No separate routine supervision log or employee score is added.

The technologist verifies workload and competence context in s1, produces assignments in s2-s3 and observes actual problems in s5-s6 before capturing unresolved items in s7. Capture is counted; uncertain competence or missing workload data is manually checked.

Workload views remove 3 of 15 navigation hours; staffing headings remove 1 of 10 allocation-writing hours; existing unresolved-item fields remove 0.5 of 5 update hours. No common percentage determines these distinct cuts.
Ordinary author saves remain retained without approval. Staff communication is s4 with its final-version gate; no automatic allocation or escalation is implied.
research_questions: Does native context and work-plan reuse remove actual repeated actions after checking staffing constraints?

already_counted.description: Capture actual assignments and later unresolved support items

incremental.description: Maintain workload links and work-plan fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact assignments, priorities and staff recipient set in the checked s3 plan; changes invalidate the communication check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=95.5, gross 4.5 less 1 upkeep gives 3.5 net. Incompatible workload metadata retains all navigation and unresolved-item writing, leaving one allocation hour removed and offset by upkeep. Usable current workload retaining 13 navigation, 9.5 allocation and 4.5 update hours plus other 70 and 1 upkeep yields 2 net. Assignment judgement, communication, observation and coaching remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain laboratory suitability judgement and supervision while reducing real method and communication repetition.
reach: Make specimen remediation specific and usable
Keep staff assignments and unresolved work explicit
skills_to_grow: Capture rejection reasons before using standard wording
Separate staff assignments from their communication
role.ambitious_version: A technologist with accessible current procedures and clear specimen and staffing records who personally judges methods and supports laboratory staff.
